payload.intro: Berty and I see so many Lunar mages. I teach them a teleport, if they ask me nicely!
payload.prompt: Which teleport spell do I teach Lunar mages?
payload.explanation: With Lunar Diplomacy done, 71 Magic and the Lunar spellbook active, Baba Yaga teaches you Ourania Teleport.

payload.intro: Nature runes, nature runes! The better you get, the more each essence gives you.
payload.prompt: At what Runecraft level do you always craft two nature runes per essence?
payload.explanation: Nature runes need 44 Runecraft, and from 91 every pure essence makes two.

payload.intro: Turn a thing into gold, dearie! Fire runes, yes, but what else?
payload.prompt: Besides fire runes, which rune does High Level Alchemy need?
payload.explanation: High Level Alchemy takes five fire runes and one nature rune, and turns an item into coins.

payload.intro: Berty and I peeked into the Temple of the Eye once. Such a commotion down there!
payload.prompt: Which minigame takes place in the Temple of the Eye?
payload.explanation: Guardians of the Rift is the Runecraft minigame in the Temple of the Eye, where you craft runes to power the Great Guardian.

payload.intro: Moonclan mages are so vengeful! But how much Magic does it take to strike back?
payload.prompt: What Magic level do you need to cast Vengeance?
payload.explanation: Vengeance is a level 94 Lunar spell that sends 75% of the next hit you take back at the attacker.
